confidence_notes: Current Takayama and Japan-wide cost-of-living aggregates inform the food, coffee, and beer estimates. Cocktail is inferred relative to local beer; wine uses a local menu reference. Lodging is a holistic July estimate with substantial property and seasonal variation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink estimates use Takayama cost-of-living data cross-checked against Japan-wide typical prices. Lodging reflects general knowledge of a small, popular Japanese tourism city in July.
